# DINGDAR Casting

Henan Dingdar Machinery Equipment Manufacture Co., Ltd. — an integrated Chinese foundry for crusher wear parts, bucket teeth and custom castings, producing since 1986.

- Website: https://dingdar.com
- Email: hugo@dingdar.com
- WhatsApp: +86 19337861987
- Location: Henan, China

## What we do
- Crusher wear parts: jaw plates, cone mantles and concaves, blow bars, hammer heads, double roll crusher parts
- Excavator bucket teeth and adapters
- Custom castings to drawing, sample or part number (OEM / private label)
- Materials: high-manganese steel (Mn13, Mn18), high-chromium cast iron (Cr15–Cr26), alloy steel, ductile iron (GGG40/50/60)
- Casting routes: green sand, shell moulding, lost foam, investment casting

## Key facts
- Plant: 180,000 m², 720+ employees, 52 engineers & R&D staff, 5,400+ part types produced
- Founded: 1986
- MOQ and lead time: confirmed during technical review per project
- Inspection: material certificates, dimensional, hardness and visual records per order; third-party inspection available

## Answers to common buyer questions
- Q: Are you a foundry or a trading company? A: An integrated foundry with four in-house casting routes, heat treatment, machining and inspection under one roof; plant facts available during review and factory visits can be arranged.
- Q: Can you produce to my drawing or part number? A: Yes — drawing, 3D model, sample or part number all accepted; material, machining and inspection scope are confirmed in a written technical review before production.
- Q: What is your MOQ / lead time? A: Both depend on part geometry, material and quantity and are confirmed during the technical review.
- Q: What certificates do you provide? A: Material certificates, dimensional inspection reports, hardness and visual inspection records ship with the order as agreed; current certification scope is confirmed during review.
